content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) emphasizes the importance of reducing the intake of saturated fats and replacing them with unsaturated fats to lower the risk of cardiovascular disease. Individuals with type 2 diabetes are advised to follow a Mediterranean-style dietary pattern that is abundant in unsaturated fats derived from sources such as olive oil, nuts, and fish. This dietary approach has been demonstrated to enhance glycemic control and improve lipid profiles.
